title: Customizations In Place
description: 3 · Agent Profile — a home in the Agents window (future sessions). "Agent profile" sits at the top of the sessions sidebar and replaces the session view with "Your defaults for <harness> sessions in vscode": the default agent, plus your guidance, skills, connections and hooks, each with a default switch. What the repo provides sits behind "Everything this repo provides". Changes save immediately. New sessions show the current defaults above the composer, and every session captures a versioned snapshot, so older sessions show "Started from an earlier profile". Vetted and cut by the design council (2 review rounds).
